selection_reason: Comparable ROC-AUC to Random Forest/Extra Trees (0.9711 vs 0.9777/0.9755) but far lower overfitting (0.0132 gap vs 0.0867/0.0928) - better generalization expected on unseen data
known_limitations: 5,390 rows have suspected placeholder participation dates; model may reflect this data quality pattern rather than genuine behavioral signal for those providers. False positives average 0.6749 predicted probability, close to the Case 2 threshold of 0.70 - some Case 2 'opportunities' will be genuine false positives, not confirmed outreach candidates.
